annotations.title: Search doctors and hospitals by name

description: Searches OpenHealth's public records for a doctor or hospital by name. Returns up to 10 matches with the doctor's NPI or the hospital's CCN, the city, the state and the OpenHealth page. A hospital search needs a two-letter state. A doctor search can be narrowed by state. When no doctor has the exact name, it returns doctors with similar names and marks them.

kind.description: doctor or hospital. The default is doctor.

name.description: The doctor's or hospital's name, such as Matthew Bernhard or Riverside Methodist.

state.description: A two-letter US state code, such as OH.
